status: Whole admitted cross-resource sendfile/splice subsystem migrated; remaining owner boundaries retained in the shared architecture inventory.

validation.scope: Affected shared kernel, Linux ABI, VFS, source wait/signal execution and Mac product. Unchanged CPU/GPU/media/rootfs validations reused.
validation.test_stack: Two existing virtual TCP handshake tests use a local 8 MiB debug harness stack; full native Linux ABI suite passes without a global stack override. Production stacks are unchanged.

method.ordering: counterbalanced before/after pairs; diagnostics separate from unprofiled timing
method.timer: longest worker; file/thread/barrier setup, final file verification, cleanup and process startup/teardown excluded; per-sample process wall retained
method.idle: compilation finished and existing six-vCPU VZ native Linux reference instance stopped before Mac samples
method.macos_native: Native Darwin sendfile for file/socket; checked read/write or pread/pwrite for pipe routes, because Darwin has no Linux splice
method.native_linux: Exact same static ARM64 musl ELF on existing VZ Linux/ext4; reference only, not the product execution architecture
method.provenance: Measured developer binary was built from the exact source hashes here before the paired runtime pin commit; its embedded runtime revision was still the baseline. Post-pin rebuild changes version/provenance metadata; actual changed source bytes are identical.

discarded_first_implementation.reason: Immediate joined transfers built retained islands on every call; native disk completion fell through a fixed sleep instead of notification parking. Final code borrows original VFS for short ready calls and reuses source wake notifications.

limitations: Microbenchmark timings are not Firefox or whole-application speedups.
Native API/backing/kernel/compiler and durable storage policies differ; these references do not isolate pure coordinator overhead or establish generally native speed.

The first final five-pair private socket/pipe single-worker median regressed 9.6% in latency; the additional nine-pair median improved 1.9%. Both raw sample sets are retained, with no stable speedup claim for that case.
No zero-copy claim: bounded owned staging and original resource locks remain.
Actual mapped-file layout changes, excluded owner/dynamic resources, task/lifecycle/namespace topology and masked owner waits keep their existing boundaries. tee/vmsplice are not added.
No physical iPad test or new iPad binary installation is claimed.
